decisions.issue: Shared helper missing when the original consumer was authored, later help-only optional reuse
decisions.action: Reuse existing module; explicit non-overwriting install and read-only compatibility inspection. No automatic game migration or engine selection.

decisions.issue: Format align/verticalAlign versus production CSS-only style vocabulary
decisions.action: Normalize these documented aliases once in shared surface; preserve conflicts/unsupported fields as actionable errors, not silent drops.

decisions.issue: Fresh-context loss of implicit decisions and unknown interrupted work
decisions.action: Explicit focused mode only for work/change after an ended, quiesced prior turn. Default/discussion/continuation keep resume. Preserve current requirements, literal prior user messages and recorded Question answers; omit old model/tool history. Do not replay shell permissions or claim unrecorded implicit decisions are retained.

decisions.issue: Repeated geometry retrieval and invalid game-view guesses
decisions.action: Selected-node geometry in existing layout CLI, with available IDs on invalid input; no new checker/pipeline.

decisions.issue: Proposed cross-measurement build caching has unproven invalidation/recovery semantics
decisions.action: Defer caching. Batch observation already supported; retain actual new checks and exact version evidence.

sideEffects: Shared module still has limited render/style/binding coverage; custom Canvas/gameplay remains project responsibility.
Focused context loses old assistant-only assumptions and loaded Skill bodies; record old loads as not transferred, retain method discovery without enabling settings/hooks.
Focused mode is explicit, not an automatic cost fix or guaranteed adoption. Large literal user history can still grow; no claim of zero missing semantic context.
No real game fixes, complete quality pass or paid Token reduction established by synthetic regression.
implementationScope: BGS integration and shared scene-editor consumer only
No formal frontend/native/builtin-tools or project artifact edits
No role/Review prompt addition, model or Agent limits

consumer.limits: Not all roles/styles/rich content, project data.action/data.variant or dynamic game behavior are implemented; static support diagnostic is not runtime acceptance.

execution.focusedAllowed: Explicit work/change after an ended quiesced previous turn; active writer, failed/interrupted previous work and discussion/continuation do not silently reset.
execution.persistedHistory: Chat and previous native histories retained; new native context only skips their model replay.
execution.facts: Current requirements, literal prior V3 messages, ordinary Chat user messages, recorded Question answers/refusals; no old assistant/tool/thinking history or shell/network permission grants.
execution.skills: Old loads marked not-transferred; ordinary native method discovery stays enabled, no settings/hooks expansion.

diagnostics.result: Selected resolved rectangles, source input identity, explicit host vs parent-local spaces and available IDs on missing targets.

implementation.deferred: Cross-measurement build cache and automatic consumer/context adoption are not implemented; no new scheduler/limit.

syntheticMessageCharacters.meaning: Observed message body characters in the controlled transport fixture, not actual token savings or autonomous model capability.
